sample.description: Empirical correlation graph of NASDAQ-100 constituents per paper definition: tickers_union 101 attempted (all appendix tables), 98 successfully fetched via Yahoo Finance yahoo_fin for 2020-01-01 to 2024-11-20, no filters applied (paper states 'No filters stated'). All 98 fetched tickers retained as fully connected weighted graph K_n (n=98) with w_ij=sqrt(2(1-Cij)). Pearson C from log returns log(adj_close) using pairwise complete observations (to keep IPO-limited tickers without trimming sample).
sample.differences: Paper nominal n=100, appendix union n=101 (66+35=101 discrepancy). Fetched n=98 via Yahoo Finance (missing ['ANSS', 'EA', 'WBD'] due to delisting/data gap); retained all 98 without trimming to nominal. No extra beyond fetched definition; missing vs nominal due to data availability and index rebalance, not trimming.
sample.cannot_count: Exact paper NASDAQ-100 vintage (wiki_nasdaq) not archived and quarterly rebalancing means nominal 100 list changes; fetched 98 vs union 101 vs nominal 100 differences cannot be precisely counted against unknown vintage.

not_rebuilt.L1_cluster_A_66: Hierarchical surgery clustering requires subjective zero-curvature threshold and neckpinch identification; flow under weighted measure (required for curvature spread) converges to uniform positive curvature 0.505 with no neckpinch, so partition cannot be deterministically rebuilt from public data alone.

sample.substitutions: Yahoo Finance via market_data live (same source yahoo_fin). Log returns (paper says r_i unspecified; log vs simple <1% corr diff). Pairwise complete correlation to retain all fetched tickers without trimming (instead of common-window dropna). GraphRicciCurvature OllivierRicci alpha=0.5 base=e exp_power=2 (Ni et al. 2019 github) for weighted mass; paper appendix describes uniform measure but that yields constant curvature 0.505 independent of w (proved W=(alpha-beta)d => kappa=(1-alpha)n/(n-1)), so weighted measure required for spread; library default referenced as github. APSP via floyd_warshall as in library; empirical w satisfies triangle inequality so d=w. Flow w^{(l+1)}=(1-kappa)d per paper. Window years computed from actual data dates, not printed 5.

notes: Choices paper leaves open: returns definition (log vs simple) - used log; risk-free not needed; ticker proxy - union of appendix tables (101) as closest to wiki_nasdaq; actual NASDAQ-100 vintage varies quarterly and wiki fetch blocked, so union used; calendar - trading days only, pairwise complete to avoid trimming IPO-limited tickers (ARM 2023-09-14, GFS 2021-10-28, GEHC 2023-01-04, CEG 2022-02-02, ABNB 2020-12-10, DASH 2020-12-09); currency USD. Deviations: sample not trimmed to nominal 100; all fetched tickers retained (n=98) with pairwise correlation; theoretical benchmarks recomputed from empirical n to avoid hardcoding paper n=100. N_NASDAQ100_nominal now reports empirical n with n=observations (previous version incorrectly set n=100). Uniform curvature would be constant 0.505 independent of w (derivation above); paper histogram spread therefore requires weighted mass exp(-w^2) as in Ni et al. code cited - used. Ricci flow with weighted measure shrinks toward empirical limit 0.505, not expand to 3: after 5/10/20 w mean 0.59/0.001/1e-6 vs paper claim flattening/expansion and surgery weight ~3 (theoretical lower bound -1.96 => 2.96). Our flow yields all positive curvature converging to empirical limit and no neckpinch zero links; paper surgery criterion not reproducible. Cluster tallies omitted as not_rebuilt (subjective). Correlation avg 38% vs paper 38% (now 38.0% with full sample pairwise), edge weight avg 1.10 vs 1.11 within sampling error. All counts now reflect empirical sample, no hard-coded nominal.
